definitions.label: Newly arrived
definitions.definition: Current stage started within 7 days, including day 7.

definitions.label: Approved priority
definitions.definition: Open cases ranked under an owner-approved ranking policy; not AI advice.
definitions.limitation: Ranking policy approval with a named owner is not recorded.

definitions.label: Stale evidence
definitions.definition: Last supplied EPC record older than 30 days, Survey record older than 180 days, or a technical sign-off marked Needs reassessment. These are review triggers, not expiry dates.

definitions.label: Blockers
definitions.definition: Recorded safety, stock or shared-building stops, or unmet final-check prerequisites. A future-step prerequisite does not stop the current stage.

definitions.label: Overdue tasks
definitions.definition: A recorded pending handoff, resident update, nomination or self-referral next update, or external safety-service deadline is before the snapshot and completion is not evidenced. Not a statutory calculation, and never a priority or eligibility change.

definitions.label: Unowned handoffs
definitions.definition: Sent, received or escalated handoffs without accepted ownership. The sender retains chase responsibility; a proposed receiver is not a confirmed owner.
